messages:
alex: Deploy to prod finished — rolling canary -> 100% at 18:07 UTC. I'm running a lightweight verification sweep (non-blocking). Checklist:
- health endpoints
- 95th latency
- error rate
- model fallback checks
Will mark updates here. @lina-sre you're on watch, @kai can you sanity the config?

deploy-bot: :rocket: Deployment succeeded — release/2026.3.5 -> prod. Canary duration: 10m.

maria: quick note — running the basic request smoke now, sending batch of 50 synthetic prompts through prod-route-1.

kai: Saw a small CPU bump on pool-gpu-2 around the switch, 10–15% for ~90s. No errors. Logs excerpt:
```
[2026-03-17 18:08:10] pool-gpu-2: cpu 78% -> 92% -> 79%
[2026-03-17 18:09:40] no OOM, no worker-restarts
```

lina-sre: I'll keep pager open for the next 30m. If error rate spikes > 0.5% or 95th latency > 350ms, escalate. Rollback plan ready: `rbctl rollback release/2026.3.5`.

alex: thanks. maria — any output mismatches in the eval set? Also quick config tweak: noticed `MAX_BATCH_TOKENS` was 2048 on a couple of tails; bumped to 1024 to tighten latency. Patch posted: `git push origin fix/batch-tokens`.

maria: Eval set is green, diffs within expected variance. One prompt had slightly longer completion but quality OK. Metrics: 95th = 310ms -> 325ms during spike, now back to 300ms.

kai: pushed token change and restarted workers: `systemctl restart redwood-worker` on the two affected hosts. Health checks returning 200. curl check: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://prod.api.redwood/v1/health` -> 200.

lina-sre: Confirming: error rate at 0.08% over the last 5m, CPU back to baseline. No rollback needed. I'll keep monitoring. :white_check_mark:

alex: sweet. I'll close the sweep in 10m unless anyone sees regression. Thanks all — note added to the release doc (link: https://docs.internal/releases/2026.3.5).
